name: Evergreen Boys & Girls State
what_you_do: Spend a week at Warm Beach Conference Center running a mock city, county and state government. You join a party, hold an office, run elections and make laws.
who_can_apply: Any high school junior, typically a 16 or 17 year old finishing 11th grade. No political experience is needed. The program is for both boys and girls.
pay_detail: The program is valued at $700 with meals and housing. A local American Legion Post can sponsor a student for $350 on request, and help for the full $700 is available on request. The site says cost is not a barrier.
duration: One week. 2027 session: Sunday June 20 to Saturday June 26, 2027.
deadline_text: The page has Apply Now links for 2027 but does not say whether applications are open, and no deadline is posted. Spaces are limited each year, so apply early. The session is June 20 to 26, 2027. Check ebgs-wa.org before you plan on it.
how_to_apply: Apply yourself with the online application at ebgs-wa.org/apply. Or ask a teacher, counselor or local American Legion Post to nominate you. They use the program's nomination form. After screening, the program helps find a sponsor if you need one.
notes: The site describes a 7-day, 6-night leadership experience. Confirm the 2027 dates on the main page of ebgs-wa.org.
